senses.gloss: to become intertwined, to turn into a pile(?)

stems.sensesRaw: to become intertwined, to turn into a pile(?)

examples.turoyo: Azzən aǧ ǧulayḏan w dəṯṯe lu uti. Uti rabo du bəxur. Yaʕni bu dəxono. Mḥalqənne, mgaʕgəsi, šaʕiṯi flan. Mayiṯi aq qalmanək, kulle azzən
examples.translation: Our and their clothes went to ironing. A big steam iron. With steam. They were thrown, became (?) intertwined and yellow. These lice died, they all perished
examples.raw: Azzən aǧ ǧulayḏan w dəṯṯe lu uti. Uti rabo du bəxur. Yaʕni bu dəxono. Mḥalqənne, mgaʕgəsi, šaʕiṯi flan. Mayiṯi aq qalmanək, kulle azzən 'Our and their clothes went to ironing. A big steam iron. With steam. They were thrown, became (?) intertwined and yellow. These lice died, they all perished' (XB 928)
